document_title: Configuration File - How Each Setting Affects What You See
description: What each setting in config.json does and what changes in your experience when you modify it

where_to_find_config.location: config.json in your main project folder
where_to_find_config.how_to_edit: Open with any text editor (Notepad, VS Code, etc.)
where_to_find_config.when_changes_take_effect: Next time you start the program or process a new book

voice.what_you_see_normally: When you select Edge-TTS, it suggests: 'Enter voice (default: en-US-GuyNeural):'
voice.if_you_change_default: The suggested voice in the prompt changes to your new default
voice.example_change: Change 'en-US-GuyNeural' to 'en-US-JennyNeural' for a female voice

background_volume.what_this_affects: If you have added a background music file, this controls how loud it plays
background_volume.if_set_to_0.5: Background music plays at half volume
background_volume.if_set_to_1.0: Background music is at full volume (may overpower the narration)

tts_speed_default.if_you_change_to_plus_10: The prompt shows '(default: +10%)' and your audiobooks will be 10% faster by default
tts_speed_default.what_faster_sounds_like: Narrator speaks more quickly, good for action scenes
tts_speed_default.what_slower_sounds_like: Narrator speaks more slowly, more dramatic

max_concurrent_tts.what_you_see_when_set_to_4: Progress bar shows 4 chapters processing at the same time
max_concurrent_tts.what_you_see_when_set_to_1: Chapters process one by one (safer but slower)
max_concurrent_tts.if_set_too_high: You might see: '⚠️ High concurrent TTS may cause memory issues'
max_concurrent_tts.recommendation: Keep at 4 unless you have less than 8GB RAM

retry_attempts.what_this_controls: How many times the program tries again if audio generation fails
retry_attempts.if_set_to_3: Only retries 3 times before giving up

piper_model_path.what_this_affects: Which voice model is used when you select Piper without choosing a specific model
piper_model_path.how_to_change: Put the filename of any .onnx model in your piper_models folder

piper_length_scale.what_this_controls: Piper speaking speed (separate from the general speed setting)

when_true.what_your_thumbnail_looks_like: Book title and chapter range appear on the cover image
when_true.example: 'The Uzumaki Legend' and 'Chapters 1-10' displayed on thumbnail

when_false.what_your_thumbnail_looks_like: Just the plain cover image from the EPUB, no text
when_false.when_to_use_this: If your cover already has text or you want a cleaner look

when_true.what_happens_on_youtube: Viewers see clickable chapters in the video progress bar
when_true.example: They can click 'Chapter 3: The Battle' and jump right to it

when_false.what_happens_on_youtube: Video is one continuous segment with no navigation

when_true.what_you_see_during_processing: '📝 Generating subtitles...' followed by transcription progress
when_true.what_your_video_has: Word-by-word captions at the bottom of the screen

when_false.what_your_video_has: No captions, just the cover image and audio

when_true.what_your_video_has: Subtitles are permanently burned into the video
when_true.benefit: Works everywhere, viewers always see subtitles

when_false.on_youtube: Upload both files, viewers can toggle subtitles on/off

Fast.when_to_use: Quick tests to check if everything looks right

High.when_to_use: Final uploads where quality matters most

what_you_can_customize.font: Default 'Montserrat-Bold' is the modern YouTube style
what_you_can_customize.font_size: 70 is default, increase for larger text
what_you_can_customize.stroke_width: 5 is default, increase for thicker outline

presets.Modern: Bold white text with thick black outline (YouTube style)

intro.what_this_is: The text spoken at the very beginning of every video
intro.default_text: Yo legends! Welcome back to the channel...
intro.if_you_change_it: Every new video starts with your custom intro instead
intro.tip: Keep it short (under 30 seconds spoken) to not annoy viewers

outro.what_this_is: The text spoken at the very end of every video
outro.default_text: Alright legends, that's it for today! If you're ready for the next chapter...
outro.if_you_change_it: Every video ends with your custom call to action

tagline.what_this_is: Your channel catchphrase added to YouTube descriptions
tagline.where_it_appears: At the bottom of auto-generated YouTube description files

max_batch_size.what_you_see: When selecting chapters, you cannot select more than this number per batch

ram_warning_threshold_mb.what_this_triggers: A warning when your free RAM drops below this amount
ram_warning_threshold_mb.default_1500: Warning appears if less than 1.5 GB RAM available
ram_warning_threshold_mb.what_you_see: '⚠️ Low memory warning: Only 1200 MB available'

min_disk_space_gb.what_this_triggers: A warning before processing if you don't have enough disk space
min_disk_space_gb.default_2.0: Warning if less than 2 GB free
min_disk_space_gb.what_you_see: '⚠️ Low disk space: Only 1.5 GB available. Videos may fail to save.'

when_true.then: '✅ Cleaned up 500 MB of temp files older than 5 days'

when_false.what_happens: No automatic cleanup, temp files accumulate
when_false.warning: Your disk may fill up over time

max_temp_age_days.default_5: Files older than 5 days are deleted
max_temp_age_days.if_set_to_1: Files older than 1 day are deleted (more aggressive)
max_temp_age_days.if_set_to_30: Only files older than 30 days are deleted (keeps more)

when_true.what_happens_on_error: Program tries to fix the problem automatically
when_true.what_you_see: '🔄 Attempting recovery...' followed by the fix

when_false.what_happens_on_error: Processing stops immediately with error message
when_false.when_to_use_this: If you want to manually handle all errors

when_false.what_you_see: 'Apply fix: Switch to Piper offline voice? (y/n)'

when_true.what_happens: Safe fixes are applied automatically without asking

pronunciation_fixes_section.what_this_does: Replaces words before sending to TTS so they're pronounced correctly

example.result: Every time 'Sasuke' appears, TTS sees 'Soss-kay' instead

banned_words_section.what_this_does: Censors words in subtitles only (audio is unchanged)

what_happens.in_audio: Words are still spoken normally (TTS doesn't censor)

banned_words_section.why_use_this: Keep subtitles advertiser-friendly for YouTube monetization

fandom_tags_section.what_this_does: Auto-generates YouTube hashtags based on detected fandoms in your book

how_to_add_new_fandom.result: Books with 'one piece' in title get those tags
